name: Jellyfin
summary: Plays episodes from your own Jellyfin server, with its audio and subtitle tracks.
description: Connects Yume to a Jellyfin server you have an account on and streams the episodes in your own library. Matches shows by provider id (AniList, AniDB, TVDB, MyAnimeList) when Jellyfin knows them, which is exact, and falls back to a title search when it does not. Returns the real stream plus every audio and subtitle track the file carries, so the sub/dub switch and the subtitle picker work on it.

server_url.description: Your Jellyfin server. Must match the host allowed in this extension's permissions.

api_key.description: An API key from Jellyfin: Dashboard → API Keys. Grants access to your library, so treat it like a password.

user_id.description: Optional. Restricts results to one Jellyfin user's view of the library.

max_height.description: Reported resolution ceiling. Direct play ignores it; it only labels the source.

subtitle_format.description: Format Jellyfin converts subtitle tracks to. Browsers only render vtt — change this only if you know why.

allow_transcode.description: Let Jellyfin transcode when the browser cannot play the file directly. Off by default: transcoding is expensive and a direct stream is what most libraries can serve.
